original_answer: The paper conducts experiments on two datasets: AliMe and Quora [1]. The AliMe dataset is collected from the AliMe intelligent assistant system in E-commerce, consisting of 8,004 query-bag pairs [1]. The Quora dataset is a public (composed) dataset built from the Quora Question Pairs data, with 20,354 training, 2,000 validation, and 10,000 test examples [7][10].

cited_sources.text: 3 EXPERIMENTS 3.1 Dataset We conduct experiments on two datasets: AliMe and Quora. The Al- iMe dataset is collected from the AliMe intelligent assistant system and the Quora dataset is composed of a public dataset. AliMe For the AliMe service in E-commerce, we collect 8,004 query-bag pairs to form our dataset. Negative sampling is also an important part of the matching model. For each query, we use the Lucene2 to retrieval the top-20 most similar questions from the whole question candidates.

Query-bag Matching To verify the effectiveness of our pro- posed models, We design a new query-bag matching based baseline. We then extract one question in the bag as query and the other questions make up the bag in our task. Considering the negative samples, we follow the same strategy as AliMe dataset. Finally, we get 20,354 training set, 2,000 validation set, and 10,000 test set. To facilitate the research in this area, the composed Quora dataset are released4. 3.2 Setup (5) We use the Adam optimizer with learning rate 0.0001 to optimize the parameters.
